The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5b03d80e25997de7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 11-12. statement: Let H ⊂ R2 be closed, rectifiable, and locally of finite H1 measure, and assume D = R2 \ H is connected. Let (v, H) be an absolute minimizer of E0 under compactly supported comparisons, with v ∈ W1,2 (BR \ H) (R > 0), Z BR |∇v|2 ≤ C(1 + R) (R ≥ 1). There is no compact set A ⊂ H satisfying all of the following: 1. H1(A) > 0; 2. B = H \ A is closed and dist(A, B) > 0, with the distance interpreted as +∞ if B = ∅; 11 3. A contains an open subarc of H that is an embedded C1 arc. In the third condition, an open subarc means that some open neighborhood meets H in just that arc.
